## Feature Summary

Describe the feature you would like to see.

## Problem Statement

What problem or limitation would this solve? Include the affected workflow or user when useful.

## Proposed Solution

Describe the behavior you would like and how it could fit into the existing project.

## Alternatives Considered

List any workarounds or alternative approaches you considered.

## Additional Context

Add examples, screenshots, references, or implementation notes that could help evaluate the proposal.
